div.div:
Fractional GPUs. It can take a single A100 GPU and split it between multiple small research jobs (Hardware-Awareness) while still providing a centralized "Fair Share" dashboard for managers.
Best For: Large enterprises that need a polished UI and strict cost/quota management for expensive H100/Blackwell clusters.
